items.title: Record Tanker Rates Cripple U.S. Crude Oil Flows to Asia
items.text: The Iran war has made oil tanker voyages so inefficient that vessel availability has crumbled and freight costs have soared to record-highs, all but erasing the incentive for shipping crude oil from the U.S. Gulf Coast to Asia.
